title: nomue common identifier definitions
description: Shared identifier and scalar definitions for Phase 1 schemas. Identifiers are identifiers, not locators; nothing here implies retrieval.

rfc3339UtcZ.$comment: RFC 3339 timestamp restricted to UTC with a Z suffix; numeric offsets are rejected. Field ranges are bounded; exact calendar validity (month lengths, leap years) is not fully expressible in a regex and is out of scope for Phase 1.

finiteNumber.$comment: JSON numbers cannot encode NaN or infinity; raw NaN/Infinity tokens are parse errors (Phase 1 numeric model).
